Senior Frontend Engineer
Acme Robotics - Bristol (hybrid, 2 days on site)

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join the Fleet Console team.
You will own the operator-facing interface that warehouse staff use to monitor
and control several thousand robots in real time.

What you will do
- Build and maintain the operator console used in live warehouse environments.
- Work with designers to turn complex telemetry into calm, legible interfaces.
- Own your services in production and take part in a shared on-call rota.
- Mentor two mid-level engineers and review their work.
- Contribute to our design system and component library.

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
- Deep expertise with React and TypeScript in production systems.
- Strong understanding of browser rendering performance and profiling.
- Experience with real-time data in the browser, such as WebSockets or SSE.
- Demonstrable experience writing automated tests for UI code.
- Clear written communication - we are a documentation-heavy company.

Nice to have
- Experience with WebGL or canvas-based visualisation.
- Familiarity with robotics, logistics or industrial control systems.
- Exposure to Rust or Go on the backend.
- Prior experience mentoring or leading a small team.

Benefits
- 28 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Private medical insurance and a cycle-to-work scheme.
- 2,000 GBP annual learning budget.
- Enhanced parental leave.

Acme Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are
committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not
discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender,
sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Frontend developer needed. React experience required.
Send your CV to jobs@example.com.

Acme Robotics is hiring a backend engineer for our fleet services team in
Bristol. You would be joining a group of six engineers who keep the coordination
layer running for several thousand robots, so we need someone who has spent at
least four years building production backend systems and who is comfortable
owning a service end to end. Day to day you would be designing and shipping HTTP
APIs in Node.js and TypeScript, tuning PostgreSQL queries that have started to
creak under load, and taking your turn on a shared on-call rota. We care a great
deal about people who can reason about distributed systems failure modes, since
a stalled robot is a stalled warehouse, and we expect you to write tests as a
matter of course rather than as an afterthought. It would be genuinely useful if
you had worked with Kubernetes before, and anyone who has touched ROS or another
robotics middleware will find plenty to be interested in here, though neither is
a dealbreaker. We would also love it if you enjoyed mentoring, because two of
the team are relatively junior. Compensation is competitive and we offer 28 days
of holiday.

Platform Engineer
Acme Robotics

The role
Maintain our internal deployment tooling. Requires 3+ years with Docker and
Kubernetes, and strong Python scripting ability.

Why join Acme Robotics?
At Acme Robotics we believe that our people are our greatest asset. We are on a
mission to transform warehouse operations, and we know that we can only do that
with a team that feels supported, valued and empowered to do the best work of
their careers.

What we offer
- Competitive salary reviewed annually
- 28 days annual leave plus all UK bank holidays
- Private medical and dental insurance for you and your dependants
- Life assurance at four times base salary
- Enhanced parental leave for all parents regardless of gender
- Cycle to work scheme and a season ticket loan
- 2,000 GBP annual personal learning and development budget
- Company pension with 6 percent employer contribution
- Regular team socials, an annual company offsite, and free snacks
- Flexible working hours and a hybrid working policy
- Employee assistance programme with 24/7 confidential support

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
Acme Robotics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified
applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race,
colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin,
disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by
law. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of
backgrounds, perspectives and skills.

Right to work
Applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. We are unable to
provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Recruitment agencies
We do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. Any CV submitted
without a signed agreement in place will be considered the property of Acme
Robotics and no fee will be payable.
